questions.subject: FILM_STUDIES
questions.learningObjective: Define and distinguish key film studies concepts
questions.stem: Which statement best defines Digital cinema?

options.text: It is the capture, distribution, and exhibition of films using digital technology.
It is the digital mastering stage where colour and effects are finalised.
options.misconception: Confuses Digital cinema with Digital intermediate

options.text: It is computer-generated imagery used to create or manipulate visual content.
It is the recording of an actor's movements to animate a digital character.
options.misconception: Confuses Digital cinema with Motion capture

questions.explanation: It is the capture, distribution, and exhibition of films using digital technology. This is precisely what Digital cinema means; the alternatives describe Digital intermediate, CGI, Motion capture, which are different ideas.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Digital cinema.

provenance.author: film-bank-author
provenance.attestation: authored from first principles; no protected content used
